## Description {#details}

<p>'list&lt;Ty&gt;' - Represent a list of element values, all of which must be of the specified type.</p>


<p>The type is stored in ElementTy.</p>


<p>Definition at line 188 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/tablegen/record-h">Record.h</a>.</p>
